title: Travel: John Lennon – Yokohama to Tokyo | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono arrived in Yokohama Port in Japan on 13 January 1971.

They had set sail from Los Angeles on 30 December 1970. The SS President Cleveland stopped at Yokohama en route to Honolulu.

They had arrived in LA the previous day. Lennon’s US visa was due to expire at the end of the year, so he and Ono boarded the SS President Cleveland to Yokohama. The steam liner was en route to Honolulu, calling en route in Japan.

After arriving in Yokohama they travelled to Tokyo, and checked in at the Tokyo Hilton hotel.
